_readme: Real-world GenAI-agent / RAG deployments on AWS, curated by hand from PUBLIC case studies and announcements.
Every entry has a verifiable sourceUrl. We store only our own short summary + facts, never copied marketing text.
This is a static, human-curated list (no scraping, no API) — add new cases by appending to `useCases` and bumping `generatedAt`.
relatedPatternIds link a case to the nine architectures in src/data/architectures so pages can cross-reference.
Facts (metrics, services) reflect the source at time of curation; re-verify against the sourceUrl before quoting.

useCases.title: Intelligent Campaign Automation for large brands
useCases.summary: Agents design campaigns, target audiences, and optimise across channels in real time, cutting manual campaign-ops work for major advertisers.
useCases.metric: Faster execution and more precise targeting at scale

useCases.title: Agentic manufacturing and quality control
useCases.summary: One agent authors test procedures for quality control; another trains vision systems for factory robots, compressing engineering effort on the line.
useCases.metric: Object-detection fine-tuning cut from days to under an hour

useCases.title: Clinical-review copilot for medical-necessity decisions
useCases.summary: Review Resolve analyses clinical records and patient data to speed health-plan medical-necessity reviews, with audit trails and multi-hour workflow memory.
useCases.metric: Expected to cut review times by 30–40%

useCases.title: R&D agents across 3G/4G/5G/6G systems

useCases.title: Group-wide agentic AI platform

useCases.title: The “Artificial Investment Associate” — LLM steps chained into an investment process
useCases.summary: AIA Labs built a system where investment specialists author “blueprints” — ordered chains of LLM queries and data-processing steps — with Amazon Bedrock chosen per step for model flexibility, and Amazon Textract parsing filings into table-aware Markdown. The analyst-facing assistant writes and runs Python, returning charts the analyst can edit in place.
useCases.metric: Analyst research passes “with the precision of a junior analyst”
